relations.description: UE wishing to transmit protocol data establishes the need to include PCO IE.
Inclusion of PCO IE is guarded by UE being in WB-S1 mode.
Inclusion of PCO IE is guarded by PDN type being different from non-IP and Ethernet.
Inclusion of PCO IE is guarded by APN not being for UAS services.
Inclusion of PCO IE is guarded by UE supporting local IP address in traffic flow aggregate description and TFT filter.
Inclusion of Extended PCO IE guards against inclusion of PCO IE.
